title: DOH ISSUES SMOKE ADVISORY RELATED TO FIRE AT ABC TOWING & PARTS IN PEARL CITY
summary: HONOLULU — A fire at ABC Towing & Parts in Pearl City is generating smoke in surrounding areas. The Hawaiʻi Department of Health (DOH) is dispatching to the scene this evening, its on-site coordinators who manage environmental emergency response.
